tasks.description: Choose a payment provider and set up an account. This will be used to process payments for subscriptions. Details to be finalized with finance and legal before build.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment provider is chosen, when the account is set up, then the payment provider is integrated into the system.

tasks.description: Determine which currencies to support and implement the necessary changes to handle multiple currencies. This includes updating the database and payment processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given multiple currencies are supported, when a user selects a currency, then the system displays the correct currency symbol and exchange rate.

tasks.description: Work with finance and legal to determine the plan tiers and their prices. This will be used to create the subscription plans in the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given plan tiers and prices are defined, when a user views the subscription plans, then the system displays the correct plan tiers and prices.

tasks.description: Determine how to handle tax for subscriptions and implement the necessary changes to the system. This includes updating the payment processing and database.
acceptance_criteria: Given tax is handled correctly, when a user purchases a subscription, then the system applies the correct tax rate.

tasks.description: Work with finance and legal to create a refund policy for subscriptions. This will be used to handle refunds and cancellations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund policy is created, when a user requests a refund, then the system follows the refund policy.

tasks.description: Create a payment flow for subscriptions that ties the payment to the user's account. This includes updating the database and payment processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has a subscription plan, when the user pays for the subscription, then the system activates the subscription and updates the user's account.

tasks.description: Create a user interface for users to pay for their subscriptions. This includes displaying the subscription plans and handling payment errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the subscription plans, when the user selects a plan and pays, then the system displays a confirmation message and updates the user's account.

tasks.description: Test the payment flow to ensure it is working correctly. This includes testing different payment scenarios and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Given the payment flow is tested, when a user pays for a subscription, then the system correctly processes the payment and updates the user's account.
